description.value: Maple Sushi is a local sushi restaurant on Dewdney Trunk Road in Maple Ridge offering a broad menu of rolls, nigiri, aburi, oshi sushi, sashimi, and sushi bowls. The restaurant supports online ordering through its own website for convenient pickup, making it a practical stop for cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley corridor. Vegetarian and vegan diners are explicitly accommodated, and the kitchen requests that customers flag any food allergies when ordering.
